### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Do not infer the 'control' or 'stability' of chronic conditions (e.g., "controlled hypertension") unless explicitly stated by the provider or directly supported by specific objective measurements and their interpretation within the transcript.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: All interpretations, classifications (e.g., BMI categories, disease stages), and statements regarding condition control or stability must be explicitly supported by the transcript's objective data and standard medical definitions. Avoid unsupported inferences or misclassifications.
[P-Section]: Report all numerical values (e.g., timeframes, dosages, frequencies) exactly as stated in the transcript. Do not alter or approximate.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately report all patient-stated symptoms, even if mild, qualified, or intermittent. Do not negate or omit reported symptoms.
[P-Section]: Limit follow-up instructions and general advice to what is explicitly stated by the provider. Do not add generic or implied instructions (e.g., "as needed") unless directly mentioned.
